messages:
Anya (PM): FYI — scoped down cut proposal attached. We need to decide which features are strictly MVP vs v1 by EOW.
Kevin (Eng): Saw it. Quick read: removing per-tenant routing and advanced cache invalidation saves ~3 sprints of work.
Priya (Eng): Confirm — removing those keeps the core API, rollout, and basic caching. Performance SLOs unchanged for MVP.
Marco (Design): From UX side, the multi-tenant dashboard is v1 for sure. MVP can reuse existing org-level controls and a stubbed tour.
Anya (PM): Proposed concrete cutlist: 1) Tenant routing (v1) 2) Advanced cache invalidation UI (v1) 3) Canary A/B dashboard (v1) 4) Dedicated autoscale policies (opt) Keep: model pinning, rollouts, tracing hooks.
Kevin (Eng): If we cut tenant routing, we need a fallback policy for customers expecting per-tenant isolation. Suggest adding a "soft-isolate" flag for Dedicated customers — cheap to implement.
Jules (SRE): Operational risk: without dedicated autoscale policies we need tighter quotas on sandbox customers to avoid noisy neighbors. Can we adopt interim limits?
Anya (PM): Yes — interim quotas for sandbox and clear migration docs for Dedicated customers. That mitigates risk and keeps launch path clean.
Priya (Eng): Timeline impact: with cuts, MVP dev + staging + 2-week soak => target feature-complete on 1966819200 (approx 3 weeks earlier than original). But we still need one full perf cycle.
Marco (Design): I'll prepare simplified flows and a static dashboard mock for MVP by Thursday. No interactive multi-tenant bits.
Kevin (Eng): Ops checklist: add quota gating, implement soft-isolate flag, stubbed tenant UI endpoints (return 501 with migration note). Estimate 6 dev tickets.
Anya (PM): Decision check — is everyone happy to lock this as our cutset and move timeline forward? If yes, I'll update roadmap and notify sales.
Priya (Eng): +1 from eng — low risk, high value.
Marco (Design): +1.
Jules (SRE): +1 with followup: I'll send quota thresholds and rollback playbook in this thread.
Anya (PM): Great. I'll publish the cutlist and update milestone tracking. Followups: Jules sends thresholds, Kevin creates the 6 dev tickets, Marco hands off mocks.
release-bot: release-bot scheduled: roadmap-update-doc published to /shared/product/roadmaps/1964208120-cutlist-vote.md
Anya (PM): Thanks team — will ping sales for messaging and set a checkpoint on Friday to validate perf numbers. :tada:
Jules (SRE): posting thresholds now: sandbox qps=50, per-tenant qps=10, token cap=200k/day.
Kevin (Eng): created tickets: INF-8816, INF-8817, INF-8818, INF-8819, INF-8820, INF-8821. Linking PRs when ready.
Anya (PM): Closing loop — milestone moved up. I'll drop a summary in the partner channel once PRs are merged.
